cindex_benchmark_washout.caption: \caption{Test C-index at six months by recurrence endpoint and washout interval. C-index estimates and confidence limits are multiplied by 100. Two-sided 95\% bootstrap percentile confidence intervals are shown. In each column, bold indicates the highest mean C-index and underline the second-highest distinct mean C-index. A blood test model is italicized when its one-sided 95\% lower bootstrap bound is above 0.5 and its paired C-index difference from the clinical baseline also has a one-sided 95\% lower bound above zero. The clinical baseline is never italicized.}
cindex_benchmark_washout.label: cindex_benchmark_individual_blood_tests_washout

complete_case_brier_washout.caption: \caption{Complete-case Brier score at six months by recurrence endpoint and washout interval. Lower is better; two-sided 95\% bootstrap percentile intervals condition on fixed fitted models. In each column, bold indicates the lowest mean score and underline the second-lowest distinct mean score. A blood test model is italicized when the one-sided 95\% upper bootstrap bound of its paired score difference from the clinical baseline is below zero. The clinical baseline is never italicized. Draws match the C-index evaluation, including draws without target events. Early-censored outcomes are omitted; these complete-case scores may be biased by censoring.}
complete_case_brier_washout.label: complete_case_brier_washout
